abort.already_in_progress: A setup is already in progress for this integration
abort.wrong_account: This login belongs to a different My Luminus account.

error.invalid_auth: Luminus rejected the email or password.
error.verification_required: Luminus asks for extra verification of this login (bot protection). Wait a few hours before trying again; repeated attempts keep the block active.

user.title: My Luminus - Add account
user.description: Enter the email address and password of your My Luminus account. Home Assistant logs in the way the Luminus app does and logs in again by itself when needed.

reconfigure.description: Change the email address or password of your My Luminus account.

reauth_confirm.title: My Luminus - Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: Luminus no longer accepts the saved login. Enter the email address and password of your My Luminus account.

tariffs_unavailable.title: Luminus {energy} tariffs could not be read
tariffs_unavailable.description: The integration reads network costs, transport costs and taxes from the detail PDF of your Luminus settlement invoices. No usable {energy} settlement was found or it could not be read, so the {energy} forecast is unavailable. It will recover automatically once Luminus issues a readable settlement. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
